methodology.selection: Four to six bounded national editorial anchors per country: general newspaper/digital newsroom, broadcaster, agency, and economic publication as relevant. No readership ranking or complete media census is claimed.
methodology.registry_match: Exact publisher domains/subdomains, reviewed aliases and country-scoped publisher names. Broad aggregator/shared feed host is never sufficient. Corporate ownership alone does not merge editorial brands.
methodology.enabled_default: Omitted enabled fields are active according to normalizeRegistry; matched_rows.enabled is the effective boolean.
methodology.presence_vs_health: registered_active denotes configured enabled HTTP(S) addresses only, not validated RSS/XML, successful article collection, or current endpoint health. HTML homepage mislabeled sitemap is needs_review.
methodology.endpoint_discovery: Primary official homepage/robots or indexed official declaration only; no guessed feed URLs, XML bulk checks, access bypass, paid model, registry mutation, collector launch or deployment.
methodology.scope_limits: Null candidate means unknown in a bounded review. Tool lookup restrictions are not publisher disappearance or evidence of production failure. Reader-market rankings are intentionally not asserted.
methodology.bounded_rss_label_review: RSS labels checked on 13 retrieved primary missing/disabled homepages. IRNA and Anadolu advertise RSS, but no extra exact feed URL is claimed without a safe declaration extraction.
